question: Which of the following nations won the inaugural under-19 women's cricket world championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won the inaugural ICC Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup held in January 2023.
 
• The final match was played on 29 January 2023 at Senwes Park, Potchefstroom, South Africa.
 
• India defeated England in the final by 7 wickets to clinch the title.
 
• Shafali Verma captained the Indian team to their historic victory.
 
• India's win in the Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup marked their first title in the tournament's history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup**:

 
 
• The ICC Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup is an international cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The tournament aims to provide a platform for young female cricketers to showcase their talent on a global stage.
 
• The inaugural edition of the tournament took place in 2023.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in Youth Cricket**:
 
 
• India has been a strong contender in various youth cricket tournaments, including the ICC Under-19 Men's World Cup.
 
• India's success in youth cricket is attributed to a robust domestic cricket structure and a focus on nurturing young talent.
 
 
 
• **Shafali Verma**:
 
 
• Shafali Verma is an Indian cricketer known for her aggressive batting style.
 
• She made her debut for the Indian women's national team at the age of 15.
 
• Shafali Verma has been a key player in India's women's cricket, contributing significantly to their successes.
 
 
 
• **Women's Cricket in India**:
 
 
• Women's cricket has gained significant popularity in India over the past decade.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has taken several initiatives to promote and develop women's cricket in the country.
 
• Major tournaments like the Women's T20 Challenge have provided a platform for female cricketers to compete at a high level.
